profile.headline:
DevOps Software Engineer Intern @ Ampere Computing 
| Computer Science & Math Double Major @ Bowdoin College
profile.summary: Complex problem solver with strong logical reasoning skills. Pursuing a double major in Computer Science & Mathematics at Bowdoin College. Three-time summer intern at Ampere Computing, under the DevOps team, utilizing collaboration and programming skills to co-develop a company-wide performance benchmarking platform and performance dashboards.

positions.title: Technical Intern - DevOps Software Engineer
positions.description: Utilized Grafana and SQL to develop fully automated and interactive data visualization dashboards for daily performance data, supporting rapid identification of bugs and performance regressions. Co-designed and implemented an improved data storage solution for daily test data utilizing BigQuery & Jira, and developed supporting CI/CD Python tooling, promoting efficient data access and future scalability. Presented data visualizations to team leaders, facilitating the identification and resolution of performance bugs.

positions.title: Data Structures  and Algorithms Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Sharpened algorithmic problem-solving skills by communicating complex coding ideas to students. Effectively collaborated weekly with 10-20 students to support successful coursework completion. Leveraged problem-solving to meticulously debug and assist students with their broken code

positions.title: Technical Intern - DevOps Software Engineer
positions.description: Collaborated in a team of 3 interns to create a company-wide benchmarking test suite for both bare-metal and cloud systems, boosting efficiency, reliability, and standardization across teams. Developed individual Python workload integrations, increasing standardization and thus simplifying communication within the company. Learned and worked with the PerfkitBenchmarker codebase, a pre-existing open-source benchmarking platform. Contributed detailed documentation to new and pre-existing code, allowing users across the company to utilize the performance platform developed
